name: Stanford-Binet Intelligence Scales (SB5)
description: One of the oldest continuously revised IQ tests, assessing five factors: Fluid Reasoning, Knowledge, Quantitative Reasoning, Visual-Spatial Processing, and Working Memory. Covers ages 2–85+.
reputation: Widely used clinical and research tool; historically significant as the first standardized IQ test.
notes: Requires trained administrator; older norms may drift.
